QuestInfo.name: Hoblin King
QuestInfo.0: Shammos has something important to say to you...
QuestInfo.1: Ask one of the 3rd Job Instructors at the Chief's Residence about Rex the Hoblin King.
QuestInfo.2: #bTylus#k has confirmed the existence of Rex. You may be able to find out more from #bRobeira#k.

0.0:
From what I can remember, my people... the Hoblins... had a very powerful king. His name was #bRe... Rex...#k It took me a long time to remember that name, but once I did, I was overtaken by emotions so powerful, I couldn't think straight for days. I felt fear. And hatred. A powerful hatred that seemed to feed me an unfathomable strength. We need to find out what happened to him, or it could mean the end of the world. You must help me! 

#L0##bWhat do you want me to do?#l
#k
0.1: I... I don't know! But one of the 3rd Job Instructors must know what to do, surely they must. Can you go ask them?

no.0: The king of the Hoblins is more dangerous than you can even imagine. You must help me!

1.0: What? You want to know about #bRex the Hoblin King#k?
1.1: Your curiosity is unwarranted. I'm not sure what Shammos has told you but I think #bRobeira#k, the 3rd Magician Job Instructor, should be told about this. She knows Shammos better than anyone. Go and report what Shammos said. After that, I suggest you forget everything you've heard about the subject.

npc.0: One of the 3rd Job Instructors should know...
